name: biostat-superpowers
description: Biomedical statistics research superpowers: composable skills for study design, data prep, analysis, causal inference, missing data, method critique, and reproducible reporting (R + Python).

author.name: Amiee Huang, Shuang Song, Zongxin Yang

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous biomedical statistics workflows for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use Biostatistics Superpowers to take a biomedical research question through its whole lifecycle: framing the estimand and study design, preparing and auditing data, choosing and fitting the right model in R or Python, identifying causal effects from observational data, handling missing data, critiquing the method, and producing reproducible, publication-ready reporting.
interface.developerName: Amiee Huang, Shuang Song, Zongxin Yang
defaultPrompt: Help me design and analyze this biomedical study.
Critique the statistical methods in this analysis.
I have a clinical dataset and a research question — where do I start?
